title: $\varepsilon$-SegFormer: Multi-Resolution Vision Transformers for Sparsely Supervised Segmentation in Electron Microscopy
abstract: arXiv:2611.27796v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Segmenting organelles in electron microscopy (EM) volumes requires dense annotations that take experts months to produce, and every gain in imaging resolution adds to this cost. Sparsely supervised methods reduce this cost to a small fraction of labeled pixels, but the convolutional networks they build on see a limited neighborhood around each pixel, while the identity of an organelle often depends on context far beyond it. We introduce $\varepsilon$-SegFormer, a multi-resolution Vision Transformer for sparsely supervised semantic segmentation, which builds on the architecture of MuViT and extends the training method of $\varepsilon$-Seg. For each labeled pixel, $\varepsilon$-SegFormer samples views at three physical resolutions centered on it, embeds their patches into a single token sequence, and encodes every token's position in image coordinates, so that attention relates all views in one shared frame. translated_title: ε-SegFormer：用于电子显微镜稀疏监督分割的多分辨率视觉Transformer
translated_abstract: 在电子显微镜（EM）体积数据中分割细胞器需要密集标注，这需要专家花费数月时间才能完成，且成像分辨率的每一次提升都会增加这一成本。稀疏监督方法可将这一成本降低到仅需一小部分标注像素，但它们所基于的卷积网络只能感知每个像素周围有限的邻域，而细胞器的身份识别往往依赖于远超该邻域的上下文信息。我们提出ε-SegFormer，一种用于稀疏监督语义分割的多分辨率视觉Transformer，它建立在MuViT的架构之上，并扩展了ε-Seg的训练方法。对于每个标注像素，ε-SegFormer以其为中心在三个物理分辨率下采样视图，将这些视图的图像块嵌入到单个token序列中，并在图像坐标系中编码每个token的位置，从而使注意力机制能够在共享的坐标框架中关联所有视图。分割头对...
tldr: ε-SegFormer提出了一种多分辨率视觉Transformer，通过对每个标注像素在三个物理分辨率下采样视图并用注意力机制在共享坐标框架中关联所有视图，实现电子显微镜数据的稀疏监督语义分割，大幅降低密集标注成本。
en_tdlr: ε-SegFormer introduces a multi-resolution Vision Transformer that samples views at three physical resolutions around each labeled pixel and relates all views through attention in a shared coordinate frame, enabling sparsely supervised semantic segmentation in electron microscopy with greatly reduced annotation cost.
